name: EduID Age Verification Credential
description: A minimal age-attestation credential derived from an eduID credential presented via OpenID4VP during OpenID4VCI. Carries age-threshold booleans — age_over_N (completed years at issuance) and over_N_this_year (reaches N at some point in the issuance year) for N in {10, 13, 15, 18, 21, 65} — plus validity dates. Which thresholds are actually populated depends on the presentation scope's age_over_thresholds derivation; the metadata lists the full superset. Assurance level is enforced at issuance time by the presentation scope's required_claims.assurance_level allow-list (see apigw.data_sources.presentation.scopes.eduid_age_verification) and is not carried on the credential itself.
